Description: Lay placemats, plates, cutlery pairs, glasses, folded napkins; align settings; stage centerpiece
Scrub each item in basin, rinse, drain, place into dish rack by type; wipe splashes

Task Name: Instant coffee and tea tray service
Description: Place cups on saucers, add sachet or grounds, pour hot water from kettle, stir, arrange tray with spoons
Wrap sandwich, add fruit, snack, napkin, utensil; fit compartments; close and latch lid; bag it
Portion three components into four containers with scoop and tongs, seat lids, stack, label
Scoop rice, beans, pasta into jars via funnel, level fill, seal lids, wipe spills, line up
Bag mixed items heavy-to-light across two bags, protect fragile, fold and stand bags upright

Task Name: Unpack groceries and sort to crates
Description: Empty two bags, sort ambient vs chilled vs produce into labeled crates, flatten bags
Load ingredients, seat lid, run blender, pour into two glasses, rinse jar, rack to dry
Load slices, run toaster, retrieve, butter with knife, plate, deliver to tray
Rinse items in basin, scrub, dry with towel, sort to colander and bowl by type
Layer fillings on tortilla, fold ends, roll tight, wrap in paper, tuck, place in basket
Arrange plate, cup, cutlery, napkin, condiments on tray; slide tray to delivery zone without spill
Refill and wipe bottles, cap, arrange caddy by slot, fold napkin stack, top up stirrers
Sort mixed utensils into organizer slots by type and size, nest measuring spoons, seat insert
Sort mixed produce by type and size into woven baskets, bundle greens with ties, weigh one batch, log

Task Name: Sort mixed recycling into four bins
Description: Classify plastics, paper, metal, glass; flatten cartons; nest cups; bin by category
Sort household objects into labeled bins by category, orient fragile items, log count per bin
Sort toys by type into labeled storage boxes, nest small into large, close and stack boxes
Stack loose papers, bin trash, pens into caddy by type, coil charger, square keyboard and mouse
Untangle, coil each cable, secure with velcro tie, sort into drawer organizer by length
Place runner, arrange vase, candles, coasters symmetrically, adjust spacing, final square-up
Trim stems with scissors, remove low leaves, arrange by height, pour water, wipe drips
Open backing tabs, insert photo and glass, close tabs, attach stand, set upright, wipe glass
Open battery doors, remove cells, insert fresh AA pairs with polarity, close, verify button press
Fold cardboard blank into drawer, seat tabs, insert divider, load six items, slide into sleeve
Sort supplies into kit compartments, band bandage rolls, check-off printed list, close and clip lid
Open seven lids, dispense from four bottles per printed chart, recap bottles, close lids, verify row
Cut paper to size, fold and tape ends, crease edges, tie ribbon bow, affix gift tag
Slit three envelopes with opener, unfold and sort contents to trays, flatten a small box for recycling
Unbox, unfold board, sort pieces to player trays, shuffle and deal cards, place dice and bank
Sort pieces into bags by color, band cards, nest trays, box components, close lid, shelve flat
Separate edge pieces from interior, group interior by color family into trays, square tray grid
Thread lace through eyelet rows in cross pattern, tension evenly, tie a secure bow, tuck ends
Fold six garments, layer by weight, fit toiletry bag and shoes in bags, compress, zip shut

Task Name: Fold five t-shirts from a pile
Description: Pull from crumpled pile, flatten, sleeve folds, half fold, stack square with edges aligned
Flatten each towel, thirds fold, half fold, stack with open edges aligned to one side
Align legs, smooth, vertical fold, thirds fold, stack by size on target zone

Task Name: Pair and fold six pairs of socks
Description: Match socks from mixed pile by pattern, pair-fold into bundles, line bundles into drawer box

Task Name: Hang four shirts on a garment rack
Description: Insert hanger through collar without stretching, straighten shoulders, button top button, space on rail
Corner-pocket nesting, edge tuck, flatten, thirds fold both axes, square the final rectangle
Work a board of zips, buttons, snaps, buckles, velcro in sequence; then fold and stack the garment
Load produce drawer, shelf items by zone, door bins; rotate older stock forward; close door fully
Pull items, group by category into bins, rotate oldest up, relabel two bags, reseat bins, close
Plate food, cover, open door, center plate, set time, run, retrieve hot-safe, uncover, stir

Task Name: Load and run the oven tray
Description: Arrange items on tray, open oven with mitt, rack tray, set dial, retrieve after timer, rest on trivet
Rack plates and bowls bottom, cups top, cutlery basket by type, add pod, close and latch, start
Unrack by type, stack into cabinet shelves, hang mugs, cutlery to drawer insert, close racks
Transfer hamper into drum piece by piece, check pockets, add pod, close door, set dial, start
Pull garments from drum into hamper, shake each once, clear the lint filter, close door, carry hamper to table

Task Name: Dress the bed pillows and throw
Description: Case two pillows, plump, stage at headboard, fold throw in thirds, drape at foot, square corners

Task Name: Insert a duvet into its cover
Description: Corner-match duvet to cover, work fabric through, shake to seat, close buttons, spread on bed

Task Name: Fit a fitted sheet to the mattress
Description: Hook all four corner pockets in sequence, tension, smooth center, tuck residual edges
Spray glass, squeegee top-down overlapping passes, wipe blade between passes, detail corners with cloth

Task Name: Draw curtains and tidy the sill
Description: Draw both panels, even the pleats, tie-backs on, clear and wipe sill, reset sill objects
Hang two coats on hooks, pair shoes to rack, keys to bowl, bag to hook, square the mat
Shelve loose books upright by size, add bookend, face spines out, clear non-books to a bin, dust shelf lip
Fold four items into a storage box, unbox four incoming, hang two, shelve two, close and stow box
Unclip vacuum, run overlapping pattern on rug zone, edge pass, empty canister to bin, dock and click
Fill bucket, dip and wring mop, S-pattern the zone, edge pass, rest mop, stage caution sign
Tie and lift full liners, sort mixed items into correct streams, fit new liners, wipe lids, seat bins

Task Name: Refill the kettle and dispenser at the sink
Description: Carry kettle to sink, fill to line, return and seat on base, top up dispenser jug, wipe drips
Water each pot to spec from can, prune dead leaves with snips, rotate pots, wipe saucer drips
Shelve items by zone and label, face labels out, rotate older stock forward, flatten the empty box

Task Name: Drive eight machine screws into a tapped board
Description: Pick screws, start by hand, drive with screwdriver to seat in threaded holes, torque-check pattern
Seat gears on shafts in order, mesh teeth, add retaining caps, spin-test, correct any bind
Route belt over two pulleys, lever tensioner, align tracking, spin-test, lock tensioner screw
Insert RJ45, USB, barrel, header, spade, ring terminals to matching ports with correct orientation
Insert stripped leads into terminal blocks per color map, screw down, tug-test each, dress wires

Task Name: Route and tie a cable run
Description: Route cable through five clips, zip-tie at three points, trim tails flush, verify slack loop
Bundle wires, tie at three stations, mate end connector, tape the branch, hang on peg
Insert eight pegs of varied geometry and clearance into mating holes, reseat any misfit
Align bushing to bore, press with hand arbor, verify flush with straightedge, next part
Sort parts, attach four legs with bolts, add braces, flip, level-check, tighten sequence

Task Name: Attach four legs to a panel
Description: Position brackets, start screws by hand, drive to seat, flip panel, wobble-test, shim if needed

Task Name: Mount drawer slides to a panel
Description: Mark from jig, align slide, drive screws, verify glide with mating rail, mirror second slide

Task Name: Hang a cabinet door on hinges
Description: Screw two hinges to door, offer door to frame, fix hinge plates, adjust cams, swing-test
Seat gasket in groove, place lid, start four corner screws, torque cross pattern, label front
Thread four standoffs to plate, seat board on standoffs, secure screws, connect two headers
Align housing halves, engage clips in sequence, press to click all edges, inspect seams, tray
Clip support trees with flush cutters, peel rafts, deburr contact points, sort parts to tray
Pull parts from six bins per pick card into kit tray compartments, count-verify, tag tray
Pick ten components from bins per BOM, orient polarity and notch marks, insert into labeled holes, seat flush, verify against diagram
Wrap threads with tape, start fittings by hand, wrench-tighten to alignment marks, cap ends
Unscrew back panel, disconnect battery lead, extract board, sort board, plastics, metal, and cell to bins, log unit
Seat stem and seal, thread bonnet, install handle with set screw, cycle open-close, tag

Task Name: Mount modules on a DIN rail
Description: Snap five modules onto rail per drawing, space and align, fit end stops, screw down leads, apply label strip
Unscrew housing, swap cartridge with correct orientation, seat O-ring, rescrew, wipe, date-label

Task Name: Apply a screen film to a device
Description: Wipe glass clean, peel film backing, align to edges, squeegee bubbles outward, inspect under lamp, tray device
Bolt motor to bracket, slide coupling on shafts, align gap gauge, tighten set screws, hand-spin
Assemble printed frame, seat axles and gears per diagram, mesh, add crank, function-test rotation

Task Name: Wire a lamp circuit on a board
Description: Mount switch, lamp holder, and terminal strip per diagram, route and screw down wires, fit bulb, test switch

Task Name: Sort green coffee beans by grade
Description: Spread scoop on tray, pick defect beans to cup, sort remainder by size into tins, weigh one tin, log counts
Measure two dimensions per part with calipers, log values on sheet, sort pass and fail bins
Gauge ten parts through go and no-go, bin accordingly, tally counts on card, flag the rejects
Rotate each part under lamp, flag defects with dot stickers, sort graded bins, note defect codes
Fit part to manifold, submerge in tank, observe for bubbles, dry with air and towel, sort result
Weigh each part, record to sheet, bin by tolerance band, zero scale between items
Apply serial labels level, scan each with reader, log to sheet, arrange units in numbered tray
Seat foam insert, place unit, add accessory bag and manual, close carton flaps, tape H-pattern
Count fastener sets into six poly bags per BOM, heat-seal or zip, label each, kit into carton
Open enclosure, swap the flagged component, reseat connectors, close, retest, relabel as reworked
File edges with strokes away from body, feel-check, wipe chips with brush, tray finished parts
Pick six chips from anti-static tray, orient notch, align both pin rows, press home without bent pins, verify seating
Seat four cells with correct polarity, clip holders into carrier, route leads to screw terminals, torque, meter-check mock
Seat board on jig pins, clamp lid, press test, read pass or fail lamp, sort board to bin, log serial

Task Name: Install a hasp and padlock set
Description: Mark and screw hasp to door panel, align staple on frame, fit padlock, key test, tag the key
Open door, unload finished part, blow chips, load stock in vise, torque handle, close, cycle start
Remove build plate, flex and scrape part off, clear debris, reseat plate, start next job at panel
Open mold halves, extract part, degate with cutters, inspect gate, tray part, close and reset mold
Position sheet against back stops, cycle press, rotate part, repeat for three bends, gauge angles
Clamp part in fixture, align to mark, drill three holes, deburr, unclamp, next part

Task Name: Hang parts in a spray-rack mock
Description: Hook parts on rack spindles with spacing, rotate rack, verify none touching, stage cart to booth
Tray parts, rack into oven levels with mitts, set timer, retrieve after cycle, transfer to cooling
Wipe three zerks, couple grease gun, pump to spec each, wipe purge, log the round on card
Release fixture plate, swap to next SKU plate and end tooling, torque, run first-article check
Load parts onto moving stub at pitch marks, orient each, remove any misfeed, keep the takt

Task Name: Check out tools from the crib
Description: Pull five tools per list from crib shelves, log each on clipboard, arrange on cart shadow foam

Task Name: Return tools to the shadow board
Description: Match each tool to wall-board silhouette, wipe before hanging, flag one missing slot on tag
Sort stray items, set tools in order, wipe bench, restage consumables, sign the checklist
Rig sling to hoist mock, guide lift over to cart, land on dunnage, unrig, secure with strap

Task Name: Run parts through a wash station
Description: Basket parts, lower into wash tank, agitate, transfer to rinse, rack to dry, log the batch
Perform the station operation on carrier, verify, advance carrier, receive next, repeat for four units
Inspect flagged items, stage photo mock, quarantine bin with tag, log condition codes, reseal rest
Count exact quantities from bulk bin into poly bags, seal, label, verify tally card
Pick fragile items to tote with paper interleaving, nest by weight, pad voids, flag tote fragile
Line insulated tote, place gel packs, load items, top gel, seal liner, lid, apply cold label
Select right-size carton, add dunnage, place items, insert pack slip, close, tape, apply label

Task Name: Pack a multi-item order with void fill
Description: Nest items by weight, crumple kraft paper into voids, shake-test, seal, label, stage to lane
Wrap boxed item in cloth square, fold and knot furoshiki style, tuck gift card, band, stage to lane

Task Name: Kit four SKUs into a bundle
Description: Gather four SKUs per kit card, band together, relabel as kit SKU, box the kits, count log

Task Name: Apply retail labels to twelve units
Description: Place price or FNSKU labels level over old codes, scan-verify each, tray in dozens
Attach swift tags at seam with tag gun mock, fold, bag, seal, sort by size to slots
Add flyer and sample into each open carton, confirm orientation, close and reseal each, tally
Cut bands, separate components, remove kit labels, sort parts to origin bins, tally card
Open damaged box, transfer contents with new dunnage to fresh carton, reseal, relabel, log swap
Scan each unit serial, log, nest into carton with separators, seal, apply serial-range label
Fold invoices into pouch, peel and stick pouch to carton face, press edges, note on manifest
Wrap strap around two cases, thread buckle, tension, trim tail, add corner protectors

Task Name: Weigh, dim, and route a parcel
Description: Weigh parcel, measure three dims with bar, log, compute band on chart, apply routing sticker
Open return, verify contents against RMA card, grade condition A-B-C, route item and paperwork
Wipe unit, replace polybag, apply new label over old, reset accessories, restock bin, log grade
Route items to restock, refurb, liquidate, scrap per rule card, tally each stream, seal scrap
Clear labels, nest totes in stacks of five, stage stacks to dolly, strap the column
Separate paper, bubble, foam to streams, flatten cartons along creases, bale-stage the stack
Inspect device, tape battery terminals mock, bag with desiccant, bin by grade, log serial

Task Name: Pick a high-value item with dual scan
Description: Dual-scan item and location, witness-scan card, seal in tamper-tag tote, log seal number
Check dates across bin items, pull expired to quarantine tote, log lot numbers, relabel bin card
Peel worn labels at bench, apply fresh ones square, scan-verify each, log replaced positions
Merge contents into one bin, verify counts, relabel, flag freed bin empty, update the card
Clear station surfaces, restage supplies to marks, empty scrap, wipe bench, sign the shift log
Break stretch film, lift eight cases from pallet layer to staging conveyor keeping label out
Stack cases heavy-first in interlocked pattern, align to pallet edges, square each layer
Anchor film, wrap three ascending passes, lock top layer, tear and tuck tail, apply wrapped tag
Apply pallet labels two sides, fit corner boards, band top layer, attach placard sleeve
Shelve cases and eaches to labeled bin locations per put list, scan-confirm each, clear cart

Task Name: Pick an eight-line order from bays
Description: Walk pick list across shelf bay, pick eight SKUs to order tote, scan-confirm, stage tote
Pull six cases from rack levels to pallet in stable pattern, label out, scan each case
Move bulk stock to pick-face bins, rotate older units to front, break down empty carton, log
Relocate SKU stock between shelf levels per plan, swap bin labels, scan-confirm both locations
Count units per bin against sheet, log, recount any variance, flag discrepancy tag on bin

Task Name: Sort a batch into the put-wall
Description: Sort batch-picked items into order cubbies, scan each, flip full-order flags, clear the tote
Pick counted units from presented tote to order slots, confirm on panel, release tote, next
Load loose items to totes, apply tote label, verify weight, push tote onto takeaway conveyor
Stop line at mock HMI, clear the wedged cartons, square remaining flow, restart, log the fault
Lift full tote off AMR mock top, seat empty tote, scan both, dispatch AMR at panel
Build a stable box wall inside container mock, heavy low, lock courses, fill voids, strap face
Move labeled cases to route lanes in stop sequence, heavy-first per lane, verify lane counts
Scan each parcel, route to one of four lane pallets, stack squarely, tally lane counts
Respond to lit locations along bay, pick quantities shown, confirm buttons, close out the order
Add zone items to arriving tote, scan-confirm, pass tote downstream, receive next, keep sequence
Push cart along bays, pick to partitioned slots by order, scan each, park cart at pack handoff
